display.purpose: Primary KPI totals and major headlines.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button with emerald carry theme.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #10b981; color: #ffffff; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #059669; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Unwind Button
components.description: Danger action button for position liquidation.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.12); color: #f43f5e; border: 1px solid rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.25); padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.22); }

narrative.overview: BHyper is designed for professional quantitative crypto arbitrageurs who manage high-stakes delta-neutral funding carry positions. Razor-sharp contrast, tabular numeric stability, and zero unnecessary visual ornament.
keyCharacteristics: Tabular monospace font for prices and rates

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: A semantic color never changes its role across screens.

rules.name: The Tabular Number Invariant
rules.body: All financial numbers use tabular monospace formatting.

dos: Do use tabular monospace numbers for all live data.
Do ensure full keyboard focus visibility.
donts: Don't allow layout shifts on WebSocket ticks.
